title: A zero time bound gives the empty class
statement: Let $T:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, and suppose $T(n)=0$ for at least one $n\in\mathbb{N}$. Then $\mathrm{NTIME}(T)=\varnothing$.
replaced:
Let $T : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ be a time bound with $T(n) = 0$ for at least one
input length $n$. Then $\mathrm{NTIME}(T) = \emptyset$: no language of binary strings
is decided by a finite nondeterministic multi-tape machine within $c \cdot T(|x|)$
steps on every input $x$, for any constant $c$.
